## The everyday decision

What can available course and assessment records tell us about learning,
and what can they not tell us?

## The evidence

The [Open University Learning Analytics Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/349/open+university+learning+analytics+dataset)
includes course presentations and assessment records from 2013–2014. Course
resource metadata is not evidence of individual engagement. A separate
platform dataset has unresolved collection-method and provenance questions,
so it cannot establish which platform is best.

The site will publish privacy-reviewed aggregates only. Learner-level records
and clickstream data are outside the published site.

## Status

Published entries will identify their observation window, limits and exact
analysis revision.
